svg.text: GPU 0's staging slots for layer l + 2: the full A(l+2) and D(l+2), gathered while layer l runs

text.font-family: Inter, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, 'Noto Sans', sans-serif

svg.text: The module tensors point into the slots, so the layer's kernels read the gathered weights in place.
